name: htesla
description: Reads your Tesla's driving, location, charging and software data from Tesla's servers and the car's own data stream; read-only — it can't unlock, drive or command the car.

config.label: this node's public address
config.help: this node's public address, e.g. https://yourname.hearthlaunch.com — must match the Allowed Origin in your Tesla app

config.label: Tesla app Client ID
config.help: from your app at developer.tesla.com (the client secret is entered on the Tesla page, where it is sealed)

config.label: Tesla region
config.help: na | eu — na covers North America and Asia-Pacific; eu covers Europe, the Middle East and Africa

config.label: telemetry port
config.help: the port your car streams to (this node must accept TCP on it from the internet, passed straight through — the car's TLS ends in the ember)

config.label: time zone for drives and charges
config.help: an IANA zone name like America/New_York — drives, charges and updates are dated in it (blank = this node's own zone, UTC on hosted nodes)
